label: first token p/q at t=0  OR  copy phase of length-3 sequences
explanation: Two unrelated components. (1) Step 0 when the first input is p or q: fires every time (precision 1.0), with a near-constant small activation (~0.028, about 0.12 of max); about 53% of active steps but only ~31% of mass. (2) Copy phase of length-3 sequences: strongest at t=4 (first copy step after <DEL>, recall_idx 1), which holds most of the mass and the top activations (up to 0.23); magnitude varies with the token, highest when the recalled token is p/q or a digit 1. t=5 (recall_idx 2) is weaker and fires only about half the time. Small residual activations at recall_idx 1-3 in L=4 sequences, often when the input is p/q. Never fires at t=1-3, at the delimiter, or at t>=8. Its p/q selectivity outside t=0 is weak.
